name: Great Aurora
description: Celestial convergence every 300 years that transforms the plane between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

description_citations.text: "Rosheen Meanderer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona uses the Great Aurora to control the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle, alternating it every 300 years.
timeline.quote: used the Great Aurora to grant herself control of the plane by manipulating its celestial cycle

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oona senses the Great Aurora approaching prematurely and plots to remain in power and unchanged through the plane's transformation.
timeline.quote: Oona began to plot to ensure that she remained in power and unchanged when the plane’s transformation occurred.

citation.text: "Oona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning boggarts into animalistic marauders.
timeline.quote: After the Great Aurora transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, the boggarts changed from troublesome tricksters to animalistic marauders.

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Boggarts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, making the kithkin furtive and paranoid and turning clachans into douns.
timeline.quote: After the Great Aurora changed the idyllic plane of Lorwyn into the fearful world of Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Kithkin", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora changes Lorwyn into Shadowmoor, turning a constantly sunny world into one of perpetual night.
timeline.quote: But thanks to the Great Aurora , everything's changed.

citation.text: "Shadowmoor", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reemerge after the final Great Aurora to control the plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.
timeline.quote: They reemerged after the final Great Aurora to control the Plane's shift between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor .

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor; features correspond but are changed, such as Kinsbaile becoming Kinscaer.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle, making Oona fear she might be affected.
timeline.quote: This continued until the cycle was disrupted over forty years ago by the Great Mending

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Rhain carries the calcifying Cerys toward the border, but she turns to stone from the waist down as they enter the aurora.
timeline.quote: Cerys was stone from the waist down.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Cerys tells Rhain his scars are beautiful, and Rhain, calcifying beside her, refuses to leave.
timeline.quote: For what it's worth, I think your scars are beautiful.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhain and Cerys turn to stone in each other's arms in the eclipsed realm.
timeline.quote: as Rhain and Cerys turned to stone in each other's arms.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Star-Crossed" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2026.
